meta.title: Intermediate To Advanced English Tenses Test

questions.question: Normally, the cadets ___ at 04:00 AM, but today they ___ late because of the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: Use simple present for regular routines ('normally') and present continuous for temporary actions happening today.

description.en: Contrasting habitual actions with temporary ongoing actions.
description.id: Membandingkan tindakan kebiasaan dengan tindakan sementara yang sedang berlangsung.

wrong_correct.wrong: Normally, the cadets are waking up at 04:00 AM, but today they wake up late.
wrong_correct.correct: Normally, the cadets wake up at 04:00 AM, but today they are waking up late.

explanation.en: 'Normally' requires simple present for habits, while 'today' indicates a temporary action requiring present continuous.
explanation.id: 'Normally' memerlukan simple present untuk kebiasaan, sedangkan 'today' menunjukkan tindakan sementara yang memerlukan present continuous.

en.introduction: This sentence contrasts a regular military routine with a temporary situation caused by rain.

rules.title: 1. Simple Present for Habits
rules.explanation: Use simple present for routines and general facts.

rules.title: 2. Present Continuous for Temporary Actions
rules.explanation: Use present continuous for actions happening around now but not permanently.

common_mistakes.wrong: They are waking up at 04:00 AM normally.
common_mistakes.correct: They wake up at 04:00 AM normally.
common_mistakes.reason: Do not use continuous tense for permanent or regular habits.

other_examples.sentence: He usually drives to the academy, but today he is taking the bus.
other_examples.translation: Dia biasanya mengemudi ke akademi, tetapi hari ini dia naik bus.

explanation.en: Contrasts normal habit with today's temporary action.
explanation.id: Membandingkan kebiasaan normal dengan tindakan sementara hari ini.

questions.question: While the applicants ___ for the Polri written test, the invigilator suddenly ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Past continuous describes an ongoing past action interrupted by a shorter, completed simple past action.

description.en: An ongoing past action interrupted by a shorter, completed past action.
description.id: Tindakan masa lalu yang sedang berlangsung yang terganggu oleh tindakan masa lalu yang lebih singkat dan selesai.

wrong_correct.wrong: While the applicants waited for the Polri written test, the invigilator suddenly was entering the room.
wrong_correct.correct: While the applicants were waiting for the Polri written test, the invigilator suddenly entered the room.

explanation.en: 'While' introduces the longer ongoing action (past continuous), and 'suddenly' introduces the interrupting action (simple past).
explanation.id: 'While' memperkenalkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung lebih lama (past continuous), dan 'suddenly' memperkenalkan tindakan yang mengganggu (simple past).

en.introduction: This sentence describes an interruption in the past during an examination setting.

rules.title: 1. Past Continuous for Background Actions
rules.explanation: Use past continuous for actions in progress at a specific past time.

rules.title: 2. Simple Past for Interrupting Actions
rules.explanation: Use simple past for the action that interrupts the ongoing one.

common_mistakes.wrong: While they were waiting, the invigilator was entering.
common_mistakes.correct: While they were waiting, the invigilator entered.
common_mistakes.reason: The interrupting action must be simple past, not continuous.

other_examples.sentence: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
other_examples.translation: Saya sedang tidur ketika telepon berdering.

explanation.en: 'Was sleeping' is the ongoing action, 'rang' is the interruption.
explanation.id: 'Was sleeping' adalah tindakan yang sedang berlangsung, 'rang' adalah gangguan.

questions.question: I ___ my UTBK study guide since I ___ it from the bookstore last month.
questions.explanation: Present perfect is used for an action starting in the past and continuing to the present ('since'), while simple past is used for the specific past event.

description.en: Using present perfect for duration up to now, and simple past for a finished past time.
description.id: Menggunakan present perfect untuk durasi hingga sekarang, dan simple past untuk waktu masa lalu yang telah selesai.

wrong_correct.wrong: I knew my UTBK study guide since I have bought it from the bookstore last month.
wrong_correct.correct: I have had my UTBK study guide since I bought it from the bookstore last month.

explanation.en: 'Have had' shows the state continues to the present. 'Bought' is a completed action in the specific past time 'last month'.
explanation.id: 'Have had' menunjukkan keadaan berlanjut hingga sekarang. 'Bought' adalah tindakan yang selesai pada waktu spesifik 'last month'.

en.introduction: This sentence combines a continuing state of possession with a specific past starting point.

rules.title: 1. Present Perfect with 'Since'
rules.explanation: Use present perfect to show an action or state that began in the past and continues now.

rules.title: 2. Simple Past for Specific Past Time
rules.explanation: Use simple past after 'since' to mark the starting point.

common_mistakes.wrong: I have had it since I have bought it.
common_mistakes.correct: I have had it since I bought it.
common_mistakes.reason: Use simple past, not present perfect, after 'since' for the specific starting point.

other_examples.sentence: She has worked here since she graduated in 2020.
other_examples.translation: Dia telah bekerja di sini sejak dia lulus pada tahun 2020.

explanation.en: 'Has worked' continues to now; 'graduated' is a finished past event.
explanation.id: 'Has worked' berlanjut hingga sekarang; 'graduated' adalah peristiwa masa lalu yang telah selesai.

questions.question: By the time the TNI commander ___ the barracks, the recruits ___ their morning drills.
questions.explanation: Past perfect is used for an action completed before another past action (simple past).

description.en: Showing an action completed before another past action.
description.id: Menunjukkan tindakan yang selesai sebelum tindakan masa lalu lainnya.

wrong_correct.wrong: By the time the TNI commander had entered the barracks, the recruits finished their morning drills.
wrong_correct.correct: By the time the TNI commander entered the barracks, the recruits had finished their morning drills.

explanation.en: The drills were completed *before* the commander entered. 'Entered' is simple past, 'had finished' is past perfect.
explanation.id: Latihan selesai *sebelum* komandan masuk. 'Entered' adalah simple past, 'had finished' adalah past perfect.

en.introduction: This sentence establishes a clear sequence of two past events in a military context.

rules.title: 1. Past Perfect for Earlier Past Action
rules.explanation: Use past perfect for the action that happened first.

rules.title: 2. Simple Past for Later Past Action
rules.explanation: Use simple past for the action that happened second.

common_mistakes.wrong: By the time he arrived, I have finished.
common_mistakes.correct: By the time he arrived, I had finished.
common_mistakes.reason: Use past perfect, not present perfect, for an action before a past time.

other_examples.sentence: After she had submitted her application, she waited for the results.
other_examples.translation: Setelah dia mengirimkan lamarannya, dia menunggu hasilnya.

explanation.en: 'Had submitted' happened before 'waited'.
explanation.id: 'Had submitted' terjadi sebelum 'waited'.

questions.question: By the time the university registration ___ next week, I ___ all the required documents.
questions.explanation: Future perfect is used for an action completed before a future time, which is expressed in a time clause using simple present.

description.en: Using future perfect for completion before a future point, and simple present in the time clause.
description.id: Menggunakan future perfect untuk penyelesaian sebelum titik masa depan, dan simple present dalam klausa waktu.

wrong_correct.wrong: By the time the university registration will open next week, I will finish all the required documents.
wrong_correct.correct: By the time the university registration opens next week, I will have prepared all the required documents.

explanation.en: Time clauses starting with 'by the time' use simple present, while the main clause uses future perfect to show completion.
explanation.id: Klausa waktu yang dimulai dengan 'by the time' menggunakan simple present, sedangkan klausa utama menggunakan future perfect untuk menunjukkan penyelesaian.

en.introduction: This sentence links a future completion to a future time marker.

rules.title: 1. Simple Present in Time Clauses
rules.explanation: Do not use 'will' in time clauses (after when, by the time, before, after).

rules.title: 2. Future Perfect for Completion
rules.explanation: Use future perfect to show an action will be done before that future time.

common_mistakes.wrong: By the time he will come, I will have left.
common_mistakes.correct: By the time he comes, I will have left.
common_mistakes.reason: Never use 'will' in the 'by the time' clause.

other_examples.sentence: By the time the exam starts, we will have reviewed all chapters.
other_examples.translation: Pada saat ujian dimulai, kita akan telah meninjau semua bab.

explanation.en: 'Starts' is simple present; 'will have reviewed' is future perfect.
explanation.id: 'Starts' adalah simple present; 'will have reviewed' adalah future perfect.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She has been studying for the civil service exam for six months, and she feel very tired now.
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous is used for the duration up to now, but the current state requires simple present third-person singular ('feels').

description.en: Showing duration of an action up to the present and its current result.
description.id: Menunjukkan durasi tindakan hingga sekarang dan hasil saat ini.

wrong_correct.wrong: She has been studying for six months, and she feel very tired now.
wrong_correct.correct: She has been studying for six months, and she feels very tired now.

explanation.en: 'Has been studying' shows the ongoing duration. 'Feels' describes the current state for a third-person singular subject.
explanation.id: 'Has been studying' menunjukkan durasi yang sedang berlangsung. 'Feels' menggambarkan keadaan saat ini untuk subjek orang ketiga tunggal.

en.introduction: This sentence connects a prolonged recent activity to a present feeling.

rules.title: 1. Present Perfect Continuous for Duration
rules.explanation: Use to emphasize how long an action has been happening.

rules.title: 2. Simple Present for Current State
rules.explanation: Use simple present to describe the current result or feeling.

common_mistakes.wrong: She study for six months and she feel tired.
common_mistakes.correct: She has been studying for six months and she feels tired.
common_mistakes.reason: Use present perfect continuous to emphasize the duration leading up to now, and ensure subject-verb agreement.

other_examples.sentence: He has been working all day, so he is exhausted.
other_examples.translation: Dia telah bekerja sepanjang hari, jadi dia kelelahan.

explanation.en: Duration leads to present state.
explanation.id: Durasi mengarah pada keadaan saat ini.

questions.question: The athletes ___ for the SEA Games for two years before the event ___ due to the pandemic.
questions.explanation: Past perfect continuous emphasizes the duration of an action before another past event, which is in the simple past.

description.en: Emphasizing the duration of an action before another past event.
description.id: Menekankan durasi tindakan sebelum peristiwa masa lalu lainnya.

wrong_correct.wrong: The athletes were training for the SEA Games for two years before the event had canceled.
wrong_correct.correct: The athletes had been training for the SEA Games for two years before the event was canceled.

explanation.en: 'Had been training' shows the duration before the past event. 'Was canceled' is the simple past passive event.
explanation.id: 'Had been training' menunjukkan durasi sebelum peristiwa masa lalu. 'Was canceled' adalah peristiwa simple past pasif.

en.introduction: This sentence highlights how long an action had been in progress before it was stopped by a past event.

rules.title: 1. Past Perfect Continuous for Duration
rules.explanation: Use to show how long something had been happening before another past action.

rules.title: 2. Simple Past for the Later Event
rules.explanation: Use simple past for the action that ended or interrupted the continuous action.

common_mistakes.wrong: They had been training before the event cancels.
common_mistakes.correct: They had been training before the event was canceled.
common_mistakes.reason: Both actions are in the past, so the second action must be simple past, not simple present.

other_examples.sentence: He had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived.
other_examples.translation: Dia telah menunggu selama satu jam ketika bus akhirnya tiba.

explanation.en: Duration before a past arrival.
explanation.id: Durasi sebelum kedatangan di masa lalu.

questions.question: This time tomorrow, I ___ the academic potential test while my friends ___ at the library.
questions.explanation: Future continuous for an action in progress at a specific future time, simple present for a simultaneous future fact in a 'while' clause.

description.en: Describing an action in progress at a future moment alongside a general or scheduled fact.
description.id: Menggambarkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada momen masa depan bersama fakta umum atau terjadwal.

wrong_correct.wrong: This time tomorrow, I will take the academic potential test while my friends will be studying at the library.
wrong_correct.correct: This time tomorrow, I will be taking the academic potential test while my friends are studying at the library.

explanation.en: 'Will be taking' shows an action in progress at a specific future time. 'Are studying' is used in the 'while' clause to describe the simultaneous state.
explanation.id: 'Will be taking' menunjukkan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa depan. 'Are studying' digunakan dalam klausa 'while' untuk menggambarkan keadaan simultan.

en.introduction: This sentence contrasts a specific future ongoing action with a simultaneous state.

rules.title: 1. Future Continuous for Specific Future Time
rules.explanation: Use to describe an action that will be in progress at a stated future time.

rules.title: 2. Simple Present in 'While' Clauses
rules.explanation: Use simple present to describe a simultaneous state or habit in the future context.

common_mistakes.wrong: While my friends will be studying, I will be taking...
common_mistakes.correct: While my friends are studying, I will be taking...
common_mistakes.reason: Do not use 'will' in the 'while' clause; use simple present.

other_examples.sentence: At 8 PM tonight, I will be studying while my brother plays games.
other_examples.translation: Pukul 8 malam ini, saya akan belajar sementara saudara laki-laki saya bermain game.

explanation.en: Ongoing future action vs simultaneous simple present.
explanation.id: Tindakan masa depan yang sedang berlangsung vs simple present simultan.

questions.question: I believe it ___ heavily tomorrow, so we ___ the outdoor military parade.
questions.explanation: Simple future for a prediction, present continuous for a fixed future arrangement resulting from it.

description.en: Combining a future prediction with a present continuous arrangement for the future.
description.id: Menggabungkan prediksi masa depan dengan pengaturan present continuous untuk masa depan.

wrong_correct.wrong: I believe it rains heavily tomorrow, so we will cancel the outdoor military parade.
wrong_correct.correct: I believe it will rain heavily tomorrow, so we are canceling the outdoor military parade.

explanation.en: 'Will rain' is a prediction. 'Are canceling' is a present continuous used for a definite future plan.
explanation.id: 'Will rain' adalah prediksi. 'Are canceling' adalah present continuous yang digunakan untuk rencana masa depan yang pasti.

en.introduction: This sentence links a prediction to a decided future action.

rules.title: 1. Simple Future for Predictions
rules.explanation: Use 'will' for predictions based on opinion or belief.

rules.title: 2. Present Continuous for Future Arrangements
rules.explanation: Use present continuous for fixed plans or arrangements in the near future.
notes: Implies a decision has been made

common_mistakes.wrong: I think it will rain, so we will cancel...
common_mistakes.correct: I think it will rain, so we are canceling...
common_mistakes.reason: 'Are canceling' emphasizes the fixed arrangement made because of the prediction, which is more advanced and natural here.

other_examples.sentence: She believes it will snow, so she is buying a new coat.
other_examples.translation: Dia percaya akan turun salju, jadi dia membeli mantel baru.

explanation.en: Prediction leads to a current arrangement for the future.
explanation.id: Prediksi mengarah pada pengaturan saat ini untuk masa depan.

questions.question: The sentence may contain 0, 1 or multiple errors. Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form. If no error, choose No Error.

multiErrorSegments.text: When I arrived at the campus,
my student ID card at home.

questions.explanation: Simple past is used for the moment of realization ('realized'), and past perfect is required for the action completed before that moment ('had forgotten').

description.en: Using simple past for a past realization and past perfect for the earlier completed action.
description.id: Menggunakan simple past untuk realisasi masa lalu dan past perfect untuk tindakan yang selesai sebelumnya.

wrong_correct.wrong: When I arrived at the campus, I realized that I forget my student ID card at home.
wrong_correct.correct: When I arrived at the campus, I realized that I had forgotten my student ID card at home.

explanation.en: 'Arrived' and 'realized' are past moments. 'Had forgotten' happened before those moments.
explanation.id: 'Arrived' dan 'realized' adalah momen masa lalu. 'Had forgotten' terjadi sebelum momen-momen tersebut.

en.introduction: This sentence shows the sequence of past events clearly.

rules.title: 1. Simple Past for the Reference Point
rules.explanation: Use simple past for the main past event.

rules.title: 2. Past Perfect for the Earlier Action
rules.explanation: Use past perfect for the action that was already completed.

common_mistakes.wrong: I realized that I forgot it.
common_mistakes.correct: I realized that I had forgotten it.
common_mistakes.reason: Use past perfect to show the action happened before the realization.

other_examples.sentence: She noticed that he had left his bag.
other_examples.translation: Dia memperhatikan bahwa dia telah meninggalkan tasnya.

explanation.en: 'Noticed' is past, 'had left' is earlier past.
explanation.id: 'Noticed' adalah masa lalu, 'had left' adalah masa lalu yang lebih awal.

questions.question: The government ___ a new scholarship program in 2020, and thousands of students ___ for it since then.
questions.explanation: Simple past for a specific finished past time ('in 2020'), present perfect for an action continuing from then until now ('since then').

description.en: Connecting a finished past event to its present consequences.
description.id: Menghubungkan peristiwa masa lalu yang telah selesai dengan konsekuensi sekarang.

wrong_correct.wrong: The government has launched a new scholarship program in 2020, and thousands of students applied for it since then.
wrong_correct.correct: The government launched a new scholarship program in 2020, and thousands of students have applied for it since then.

explanation.en: 'Launched' is a finished past action. 'Have applied' continues to the present.
explanation.id: 'Launched' adalah tindakan masa lalu yang telah selesai. 'Have applied' berlanjut hingga sekarang.

en.introduction: This sentence connects a past event to its present consequences.

rules.title: 1. Simple Past for Finished Time
rules.explanation: Use simple past with specific past time markers.

rules.title: 2. Present Perfect for Unfinished Time
rules.explanation: Use present perfect for actions starting in the past and continuing now.

common_mistakes.wrong: The government has launched... in 2020
common_mistakes.correct: The government launched... in 2020
common_mistakes.reason: Do not use present perfect with specific finished past time markers like 'in 2020'.

other_examples.sentence: They built the hospital in 2015, and it has served the community ever since.
other_examples.translation: Mereka membangun rumah sakit pada tahun 2015, dan telah melayani masyarakat sejak saat itu.

explanation.en: Finished past action + continuing present result.
explanation.id: Tindakan masa lalu yang selesai + hasil sekarang yang berlanjut.

questions.question: By next month, I ___ at this police academy for exactly one year, and I ___ ready for the final assessment.

options.C: will be studying / will have been
options.D: will have been studying / will be

questions.explanation: Future perfect continuous for duration up to a future point, simple future for the resulting state.

description.en: Projecting a duration into the future and stating a future result.
description.id: Memproyeksikan durasi ke masa depan dan menyatakan hasil di masa depan.

wrong_correct.wrong: By next month, I will study at this police academy for exactly one year, and I will have been ready for the final assessment.
wrong_correct.correct: By next month, I will have been studying at this police academy for exactly one year, and I will be ready for the final assessment.

explanation.en: 'Will have been studying' emphasizes the duration up to 'next month'. 'Will be' is the simple future state.
explanation.id: 'Will have been studying' menekankan durasi hingga 'bulan depan'. 'Will be' adalah keadaan simple future.

en.introduction: This sentence projects a duration into the future and states a future result.

rules.title: 1. Future Perfect Continuous for Future Duration
rules.explanation: Use to emphasize how long an action will have been in progress at a future time.

rules.title: 2. Simple Future for Result
rules.explanation: Use simple future to state the condition at that future time.

common_mistakes.wrong: By next month, I will be studying for one year.
common_mistakes.correct: By next month, I will have been studying for one year.
common_mistakes.reason: Use future perfect continuous to emphasize the duration leading up to a future point.

other_examples.sentence: By 2025, she will have been teaching for a decade, and she will retire.
other_examples.translation: Pada tahun 2025, dia akan telah mengajar selama satu dekade, dan dia akan pensiun.

explanation.en: Future duration + future state.
explanation.id: Durasi masa depan + keadaan masa depan.

questions.question: I ___ the uniform that I ___ when I graduated from high school.
questions.explanation: Present perfect for a state continuing to the present, past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

description.en: Connecting a present possession to a specific past ongoing context.
description.id: Menghubungkan kepemilikan sekarang dengan konteks masa lalu yang sedang berlangsung.

wrong_correct.wrong: I kept the uniform that I was wearing when I graduated from high school.
wrong_correct.correct: I have kept the uniform that I was wearing when I graduated from high school.

explanation.en: 'Have kept' continues to the present. 'Was wearing' was in progress at the past moment of 'graduated'.
explanation.id: 'Have kept' berlanjut hingga sekarang. 'Was wearing' sedang berlangsung pada momen masa lalu 'graduated'.

en.introduction: This sentence connects a present possession to a specific past ongoing context.

rules.title: 1. Present Perfect for Continuing State
rules.explanation: Use present perfect for an action or state that started in the past and continues now.

rules.title: 2. Past Continuous for Past Context
rules.explanation: Use past continuous to describe what was happening at a specific past moment.

common_mistakes.wrong: I kept the uniform that I was wearing...
common_mistakes.correct: I have kept the uniform that I was wearing...
common_mistakes.reason: Use present perfect to show you still keep it now.

other_examples.sentence: She has saved the letter that she was writing when the power went out.
other_examples.translation: Dia telah menyimpan surat yang sedang dia tulis ketika listrik padam.

explanation.en: Present result + past ongoing context.
explanation.id: Hasil sekarang + konteks masa lalu yang sedang berlangsung.

questions.question: If the committee ___ the proposal today, we ___ the new curriculum by next semester.
questions.explanation: Simple present in the first conditional if-clause, future perfect in the main clause for completion before a future time.

description.en: Linking a present/future condition to a future completion.
description.id: Menghubungkan kondisi sekarang/masa depan dengan penyelesaian di masa depan.

wrong_correct.wrong: If the committee will approve the proposal today, we implement the new curriculum by next semester.
wrong_correct.correct: If the committee approves the proposal today, we will have implemented the new curriculum by next semester.

explanation.en: 'Approves' is simple present in the if-clause. 'Will have implemented' is future perfect.
explanation.id: 'Approves' adalah simple present dalam klausa if. 'Will have implemented' adalah future perfect.

en.introduction: This sentence links a present/future condition to a future completion.

rules.title: 1. Simple Present in If-Clause
rules.explanation: Use simple present for the condition in a first conditional.

rules.title: 2. Future Perfect for Future Completion
rules.explanation: Use future perfect to show an action will be finished by a future time.

common_mistakes.wrong: If the committee will approve...
common_mistakes.correct: If the committee approves...
common_mistakes.reason: Do not use 'will' in the if-clause of a first conditional.

other_examples.sentence: If we start now, we will have finished by noon.
other_examples.translation: Jika kita mulai sekarang, kita akan telah selesai pada siang hari.

explanation.en: Condition + future completion.
explanation.id: Kondisi + penyelesaian di masa depan.

questions.question: I notice that you ___ your report, so you ___ video games now.
questions.explanation: Past perfect for an action completed before a past reference (implied), present continuous for the current ongoing action.

description.en: Contrasting a completed past action with a current ongoing state.
description.id: Membedakan tindakan masa lalu yang telah selesai dengan keadaan sekarang yang sedang berlangsung.

wrong_correct.wrong: I notice that you have finished your report, so you played video games now.
wrong_correct.correct: I notice that you had finished your report, so you are playing video games now.

explanation.en: 'Had finished' shows completion before a past point (e.g., before I noticed). 'Are playing' is the current ongoing action.
explanation.id: 'Had finished' menunjukkan penyelesaian sebelum titik masa lalu. 'Are playing' adalah tindakan yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

en.introduction: This sentence contrasts a completed past action with a current ongoing state.

rules.title: 1. Past Perfect for Earlier Completion
rules.explanation: Use past perfect to show an action was done before another past time.

rules.title: 2. Present Continuous for Now
rules.explanation: Use present continuous for the action happening at the moment of speaking.

common_mistakes.wrong: You had finished, so you relax now.
common_mistakes.correct: You had finished, so you are relaxing now.
common_mistakes.reason: Use present continuous for an action happening right now.

other_examples.sentence: He had eaten, so he is not hungry now.
other_examples.translation: Dia telah makan, jadi dia tidak lapar sekarang.

explanation.en: Past completion affects present state.
explanation.id: Penyelesaian masa lalu memengaruhi keadaan sekarang.

questions.question: At 8:00 PM tonight, I ___ the online lecture, and by 9:00 PM, I ___ all my assignments.

options.D: will be attending / will have submitted

questions.explanation: Future continuous for an action in progress at a specific future time, future perfect for an action completed by a later future time.

description.en: Sequencing two future actions: one ongoing, one completed.
description.id: Mengurutkan dua tindakan masa depan: satu sedang berlangsung, satu telah selesai.

wrong_correct.wrong: At 8:00 PM tonight, I will attend the online lecture, and by 9:00 PM, I will be submitting all my assignments.
wrong_correct.correct: At 8:00 PM tonight, I will be attending the online lecture, and by 9:00 PM, I will have submitted all my assignments.

explanation.en: 'Will be attending' is in progress at 8:00 PM. 'Will have submitted' is completed by 9:00 PM.
explanation.id: 'Will be attending' sedang berlangsung pada pukul 8:00 malam. 'Will have submitted' selesai pada pukul 9:00 malam.

en.introduction: This sentence sequences two future actions: one ongoing, one completed.

rules.title: 1. Future Continuous for Ongoing Future Action
rules.explanation: Use for an action in progress at a specific future time.

rules.title: 2. Future Perfect for Completed Future Action
rules.explanation: Use for an action that will be finished before a specific future time.

common_mistakes.wrong: At 8:00 PM, I will attend...
common_mistakes.correct: At 8:00 PM, I will be attending...
common_mistakes.reason: Use future continuous to emphasize the action will be in progress at that exact time.

other_examples.sentence: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Jakarta, and by noon, I will have arrived.
other_examples.translation: Pada waktu ini besok, saya akan terbang ke Jakarta, dan pada siang hari, saya akan telah tiba.

explanation.en: Ongoing future action + completed future action.
explanation.id: Tindakan masa depan yang sedang berlangsung + tindakan masa depan yang selesai.

questions.question: The student ___ a perfect score on the math exam after he ___ for five hours straight.
questions.explanation: Simple past for the main past event, past perfect continuous for the duration leading up to it.

description.en: Highlighting the effort leading to a past achievement.
description.id: Menyoroti upaya yang mengarah pada pencapaian di masa lalu.

wrong_correct.wrong: The student achieved a perfect score on the math exam after he was studying for five hours straight.
wrong_correct.correct: The student achieved a perfect score on the math exam after he had been studying for five hours straight.

explanation.en: 'Achieved' is the completed past event. 'Had been studying' emphasizes the duration before that event.
explanation.id: 'Achieved' adalah peristiwa masa lalu yang selesai. 'Had been studying' menekankan durasi sebelum peristiwa tersebut.

en.introduction: This sentence highlights the effort leading to a past achievement.

rules.title: 1. Past Perfect Continuous for Duration
rules.explanation: Use to show how long an action had been happening before a past event.

rules.title: 2. Simple Past for the Result
rules.explanation: Use simple past for the achievement or event that followed.

common_mistakes.wrong: He achieved after he studied for five hours.
common_mistakes.correct: He achieved after he had been studying for five hours.
common_mistakes.reason: Use past perfect continuous to emphasize the duration of the studying before the achievement.

other_examples.sentence: She passed the exam after she had been studying all night.
other_examples.translation: Dia lulus ujian setelah dia belajar sepanjang malam.

explanation.en: Duration before past success.
explanation.id: Durasi sebelum kesuksesan di masa lalu.

questions.question: Currently, the city ___ a new highway, and by 2026, they ___ it.

options.D: was building / will have been completing

questions.explanation: Present continuous for an action happening now, future perfect for its completion by a future date.

description.en: Connecting a current ongoing project to its future completion.
description.id: Menghubungkan proyek yang sedang berlangsung saat ini dengan penyelesaian di masa depannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Currently, the city builds a new highway, and by 2026, they will complete it.
wrong_correct.correct: Currently, the city is building a new highway, and by 2026, they will have completed it.

explanation.en: 'Is building' is the current ongoing action. 'Will have completed' is the future completion.
explanation.id: 'Is building' adalah tindakan yang sedang berlangsung saat ini. 'Will have completed' adalah penyelesaian di masa depan.

en.introduction: This sentence connects a current ongoing project to its future completion.

rules.title: 1. Present Continuous for Current Action
rules.explanation: Use for an action happening around now.

rules.title: 2. Future Perfect for Future Completion
rules.explanation: Use for an action that will be finished by a specific future time.

common_mistakes.wrong: Currently, they build...
common_mistakes.correct: Currently, they are building...
common_mistakes.reason: Use present continuous for actions happening at the present time.

other_examples.sentence: We are renovating the school, and we will have finished by December.
other_examples.translation: Kami sedang merenovasi sekolah, dan kami akan selesai pada bulan Desember.

explanation.en: Current ongoing action + future completion.
explanation.id: Tindakan yang sedang berlangsung saat ini + penyelesaian di masa depan.

questions.question: I know that the suspect ___ the country before the police ___ to his house yesterday.
questions.explanation: Simple present for current knowledge, past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

description.en: Expressing present knowledge about a sequence of past events.
description.id: Menyatakan pengetahuan sekarang tentang urutan peristiwa masa lalu.

wrong_correct.wrong: I know that the suspect has fled the country before the police came to his house yesterday.
wrong_correct.correct: I know that the suspect had fled the country before the police came to his house yesterday.

explanation.en: 'Know' is present. 'Had fled' happened before 'came' (past).
explanation.id: 'Know' adalah sekarang. 'Had fled' terjadi sebelum 'came' (masa lalu).

en.introduction: This sentence expresses present knowledge about a sequence of past events.

rules.title: 1. Simple Present for Current Knowledge
rules.explanation: Use simple present for what you know now.

rules.title: 2. Past Perfect for Earlier Past
rules.explanation: Use past perfect for the action that happened first in the past.

common_mistakes.wrong: I know that the suspect fled... before he came...
common_mistakes.correct: I know that the suspect had fled... before he came...
common_mistakes.reason: Use past perfect to clearly show the fleeing happened before the coming.

other_examples.sentence: She knows that he had already left when she arrived.
other_examples.translation: Dia tahu bahwa dia telah pergi ketika dia tiba.

explanation.en: Present knowledge + past sequence.
explanation.id: Pengetahuan sekarang + urutan masa lalu.

questions.question: Once you ___ the registration form, the committee ___ you an acknowledgment email.
questions.explanation: Present perfect in a time clause to show completion, simple future in the main clause.

description.en: Linking a completed condition to a future consequence.
description.id: Menghubungkan kondisi yang telah selesai dengan konsekuensi di masa depan.

wrong_correct.wrong: Once you will submit the registration form, the committee sends you an acknowledgment email.
wrong_correct.correct: Once you have submitted the registration form, the committee will send you an acknowledgment email.

explanation.en: 'Have submitted' shows completion before the future action. 'Will send' is the future result.
explanation.id: 'Have submitted' menunjukkan penyelesaian sebelum tindakan masa depan. 'Will send' adalah hasil masa depan.

en.introduction: This sentence links a completed condition to a future consequence.

rules.title: 1. Present Perfect in Time Clauses
rules.explanation: Use present perfect to emphasize completion before a future event.

rules.title: 2. Simple Future for Result
rules.explanation: Use simple future for the action that follows.

common_mistakes.wrong: Once you will have submitted...
common_mistakes.correct: Once you have submitted...
common_mistakes.reason: Do not use 'will' in time clauses starting with 'once'.

other_examples.sentence: After I have finished my work, I will go home.
other_examples.translation: Setelah saya menyelesaikan pekerjaan saya, saya akan pulang.

explanation.en: Completion before future action.
explanation.id: Penyelesaian sebelum tindakan masa depan.
